notes.title: Let’s get this party started! TactiCats is available now!
notes.content:
[h3] [b]Hey there! Today is the day, the big party is about to begin! TactiCats is now available on PC and consoles![/b] 😺 [/h3]

We are extremely happy to announce it with HungryDingo -[b] you can now purchase the game with -15% launch discount and play it with your friends![/b] 🥳

Take part in fast and dynamic competitions, in which you must eliminate your opponents! Knock down your enemies, grow your collection of cute cat-players, use power-ups and complete various tasks & secret challenges in order to win. No holds barred! 🐈‍⬛ 

Time to show everybody who's the fluffiest of them all! 😼

* * *

[b]Take a look at the release trailer ⤵️[/b]

[previewyoutube=O7UMEezIdJ4;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: TactiCats is coming to PC, Nintendo Switch & Xbox and has a release date!
notes.content:
[h3] Hey there, fans of cats and furr-balls! It's time to sharpen your claws! 🐈 [/h3]

Together with Hungry Dingo we are pleased to announce that TactiCats is finally coming to launch! [b]Game will be released here on Steam, as well as on Nintendo Switch and Xbox consoles in two weeks, on February 20th, 2025![/b] 

Knock down your enemies, grow your collection of cute cat-players, use power-ups and complete various tasks & secret challenges in order to win! Time to show everyobody, who's the fluffiest of them all! [b]No holds barred![/b] 🐈‍⬛

We've prepared for you date annoucement trailer, take a look ⤵️
